verification: The bank asked for verification of my address before opening the account.
银行在开户之前要求对我的地址进行确认。
clinical: She remained clinical when she explained the test results to the patient's family.
她在向病人的家属解释检查结果时保持了冷静客观的态度。
subsidise: The government plans to subsidise public transport to reduce traffic in the city.
政府计划资助公共交通以减少市内的交通拥堵。
entrepreneurial: The course teaches entrepreneurial skills to students who want to start their own businesses.
这门课程向想创办自己企业的学生传授创业技能。
processor: The new phone has a faster processor, so apps open almost instantly.
这部新手机配有更快的处理器，所以应用程序几乎瞬间就能打开。
finitude: Reading old letters made him think about the finitude of human life.
阅读旧信件使他思考起人类生命的有限性。
enlist: My grandfather decided to enlist in the army when he was only eighteen.
我的祖父在年仅十八岁时就决定参军。
facsimile: The museum keeps a facsimile of the ancient manuscript for visitors to examine.
博物馆保存着那份古代手稿的复制品，供参观者查看。
internationalist: As an internationalist, he believed nations could solve shared problems only through cooperation.
作为一名国际主义者，他认为各国只有通过合作才能解决共同的问题。
impoverished: The charity sends food and medicine to impoverished villages every winter.
这家慈善机构每年冬天向贫困的村庄运送食物和药品。
extrusion: The factory uses extrusion to shape heated plastic into long thin pipes.
这家工厂使用挤压工艺把加热后的塑料成型为细长的管子。
seclude: After the scandal, the writer chose to seclude himself in a small mountain village.
丑闻发生后，这位作家选择隐居在一个小山村里。
aggravation: Skipping meals will only lead to the aggravation of your stomach problems.
不吃饭只会导致你的胃病加重。
corporal: Regular exercise helps reduce corporal as well as mental tiredness.
经常锻炼有助于减轻身体和精神上的疲劳。
predatory: The owl is a predatory bird that hunts small animals at night.
猫头鹰是一种在夜间捕食小动物的食肉鸟类。
bereave: The war bereaved thousands of children of their parents.
这场战争使成千上万的孩子失去了父母。
overdraft: He paid the bill from his overdraft because his salary had not arrived yet.
由于工资还没到账，他用透支支付了这笔账单。
in accordance with: Employees must handle customer information in accordance with the company's privacy policy.
员工必须依照公司的隐私政策处理客户信息。
bistro: We had a wonderful dinner at a small bistro near the river.
我们在河边一家小酒馆里吃了一顿非常棒的晚餐。
ultraclean: Surgeons must work in an ultraclean environment to protect patients from infection.
外科医生必须在超净的环境中工作，以保护病人免受感染。
bump into: I often bump into my old classmates at the weekend market.
我经常在周末的集市上偶遇我的老同学。
edify: Good documentaries can edify young people while they are being entertained.
优秀的纪录片能在娱乐年轻人的同时起到教化作用。
tangibly: The team's confidence improved tangibly after they won their first match.
赢得第一场比赛后，球队的信心明显提升，可以感觉得到。
generalise: It is unfair to generalise about a whole nation from one traveller's story.
根据一位旅行者的见闻就对整个民族下概括性的结论是不公平的。
prospectus: You should read the college prospectus carefully before choosing your courses.
在选择课程之前，你应该仔细阅读学院的招生简章。
holistically: The doctor treats patients holistically, considering diet, sleep, and stress together.
这位医生从整体上治疗病人，同时考虑饮食、睡眠和压力。
digestive: Eating slowly is good for your digestive system.
细嚼慢咽对你的消化系统有好处。
explorer: The young explorer spent two years mapping the rivers of the far north.
这位年轻的探险家花了两年时间绘制远北地区的河流地图。
at random: The teacher picked three students at random to answer the questions.
老师随机挑选了三名学生来回答这些问题。
specialise: She decided to specialise in children's diseases after finishing medical school.
医学院毕业后，她决定专攻儿科疾病。
troupe: A travelling dance troupe will perform in our town next Saturday.
一个巡回舞蹈团下周六将在我们镇上演出。
cervical: Doctors recommend regular checks for early detection of cervical cancer.
医生建议定期检查，以便及早发现宫颈癌。
discredit: The reporter's false story discredited the whole newspaper.
那位记者的虚假报道使整个报社名誉扫地。
particulate: Factories must filter out harmful particulate matter before releasing waste gas.
工厂在排放废气前必须过滤掉有害的颗粒物。
a calculated crime: Leaving no clues behind showed that it was clearly a calculated crime.
不留任何痕迹，这显然是一起有预谋的犯罪。
insularity: The island's insularity kept its old customs alive for hundreds of years.
这座岛屿与外界隔绝的生活状况使其古老习俗保存了数百年。
repack: The movers had to repack the boxes because the glass items were not safe.
搬运工不得不重新包装这些箱子，因为玻璃制品不安全。
geometric: The floor is covered with tiles in a simple geometric pattern.
地板上铺着带有简单几何图案的瓷砖。
elicitation: Careful questioning led to the elicitation of important details from the witness.
通过细致的提问，从证人那里引出了重要的细节。
conditioner: After swimming, she always washes her hair with shampoo and conditioner.
游泳后，她总是用洗发水和护发素洗头发。
